controls.label: New document
controls.tip: Start any of 17 BwB document types with the cover, contents, numbered headings, writing prompts and the disclaimer.

controls.label: Add BwB styles
controls.tip: Brings the BwB styles into this document and restyles Normal and the headings to the BwB format. Text is not changed.

controls.label: Toolkit
controls.tip: Opens the BwB Toolkit pane: styles, building blocks, the Pre-QA check and the brand guide.

controls.label: Headings
controls.tip: Candara headings in navy. Headings 1 to 3 number themselves: never type the numbers.

items.label: Heading 1
items.tip: Candara 18 pt bold navy, numbered 1.

items.label: Heading 2
items.tip: Candara 14 pt bold navy, numbered 1.1

items.label: Heading 3
items.tip: Candara 12 pt bold navy, numbered 1.1.1

items.label: Heading 4
items.tip: Candara 11 pt bold italic navy, not numbered.

items.label: Unnumbered heading 1
items.tip: For front and back matter: Executive summary, Glossary, References, Appendices.

items.label: Unnumbered heading 2
items.tip: A level 2 heading inside front or back matter.

controls.label: Body text
controls.tip: Aptos 10 pt, justified, at least 16 pt line spacing, 8 pt after.

controls.label: Text styles
controls.tip: The lead paragraph, accent paragraph, source line and pull quote styles.

items.label: Lead paragraph
items.tip: The opening paragraph of a section, slightly larger.

items.label: Accent paragraph
items.tip: A paragraph with a green rule to draw the eye.

items.label: Source line
items.tip: 8 pt italic charcoal, under a figure or a box.

items.label: Pull quote
items.tip: Candara italic navy with a lime bar. Left word for word.

controls.label: Lists
controls.tip: BwB bullet and number styles. Green squares for body lists; no more than two bullet styles on a page.

items.label: Green square
items.tip: Body lists.

items.label: Navy circle
items.tip: Secondary lists.

items.label: Green circle
items.tip: Inside callouts and tables.

items.label: Charcoal dash
items.tip: Assumptions and minor items.

items.label: Green arrow
items.tip: Actions and next steps.

items.label: Numbered
items.tip: A sequence or a ranking, in navy numerals.

items.label: Lime on navy
items.tip: Only inside navy panels.

controls.label: Clean up wording
controls.tip: Fixes house style with one right answer in the selection: UK spelling, dashes, dates, currency codes, per cent, the company name and spaces.

controls.label: Blocks
controls.tip: Callouts, notes, key figures, snapshots, pull quotes, case studies, icon grids and details tables, with grey placeholders to type over.

items.label: Callout
items.tip: A takeaway, tip or lesson, with a green bar.

items.label: Note
items.tip: A caveat or an assumption, with a charcoal bar.

items.label: Key figures
items.tip: Two to four headline numbers on a navy panel.

items.label: Snapshot
items.tip: A navy grid of key facts to open a briefing.

items.label: Pull quote
items.tip: One quotation that carries a point.

items.label: Case study
items.tip: A titled box with a row of figures and a source.

items.label: Icon grid
items.tip: Services, workstreams or principles, each with an icon.

items.label: Details table
items.tip: Label and value pairs, such as a project summary.

controls.label: Table
controls.tip: BwB data tables: navy header row repeated on each page, figures right-aligned, caption below.

items.label: New BwB table
items.tip: Four columns and four rows with a caption placeholder. More options in the pane.

items.label: Format table at cursor
items.tip: Applies BwB Standard, repeats the header row, right-aligns figures and styles a total row.

items.label: Table caption
items.tip: A numbered caption to place below a table.

items.label: Figure caption
items.tip: A numbered caption to place below a figure or chart.

items.label: Source line
items.tip: Source: ... in 8 pt italic charcoal.

controls.label: Harvey balls
controls.tip: Score options against criteria in a table. Inserted at the cursor in navy.

items.label: Empty
items.tip: 0 per cent.

items.label: Quarter
items.tip: 25 per cent.

items.label: Half
items.tip: 50 per cent.

items.label: Three quarters
items.tip: 75 per cent.

items.label: Full
items.tip: 100 per cent.

controls.label: Icons
controls.tip: Search 1,866 Lucide icons and insert them in the BwB colours and sizes.

controls.label: Document parts
controls.tip: Contents, the BwB disclaimer, the EU acknowledgement and page breaks.

items.label: Contents
items.tip: A table of contents for Headings 1 and 2, then a page break.

items.label: Disclaimer
items.tip: The standard BwB disclaimer on its own page at the end.

items.label: EU acknowledgement
items.tip: Funding statement and disclaimer for EU-funded work.

items.label: Page break
items.tip: Start the next part on a new page.

controls.label: Pre-QA check
controls.tip: Checks the document against the BwB format, house style and the QA checklist, with one-click fixes.

controls.label: Sticker
controls.tip: A status label in the page header, such as Draft or For discussion. Remove it before the final version.

items.label: Draft
items.tip: DRAFT in the page header.

items.label: For discussion
items.tip: FOR DISCUSSION in the page header.

items.label: Preliminary
items.tip: PRELIMINARY in the page header.

items.label: Illustrative
items.tip: ILLUSTRATIVE in the page header.

items.label: Confidential
items.tip: CONFIDENTIAL in the page header.

items.label: Not for distribution
items.tip: NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION in the page header.

items.label: Remove sticker
items.tip: Removes the sticker from every header.

controls.label: Update fields
controls.tip: Refreshes the contents, caption numbers, cross-references and page totals.

controls.label: Brand guide
controls.tip: BwB colours, type, house style, document furniture and icon rules.
